metadata.generationSummary:
## project-c2f6feb3 - Algerian Real Estate Marketplace

**App Type**: marketplace
**Tech Stack**: Expo SDK ~54.0.30, React Native 0.81.5

### Implemented Screens
- `app/index.tsx` - Stunning splash/onboarding screen with Electric Purple gradient
- `app/(auth)/_layout.tsx` - Auth stack layout
- `app/(auth)/login.tsx` - Login with phone/email authentication
- `app/(auth)/signup.tsx` - User registration with role selection
- `app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx` - Main tab navigation with 5 tabs
- `app/(tabs)/index.tsx` - Home with featured listings, search bar, categories
- `app/(tabs)/search.tsx` - Advanced search with filters and map view toggle
- `app/(tabs)/favorites.tsx` - Saved properties with swipe actions
- `app/(tabs)/messages.tsx` - Chat list with agents
- `app/(tabs)/profile.tsx` - User profile, settings, agent dashboard access
- `app/property/[id].tsx` - Full property detail with gallery, map, agent info, booking
- `app/agent/[id].tsx` - Agent profile with listings and reviews

### Key Files & Responsibilities
- `types/index.ts` - All TypeScript interfaces (User, Property, Agent, Message, etc.)
- `constants/Colors.ts` - Electric Purple theme with full dark mode support
- `store/useAuthStore.ts` - Authentication state, login/signup/logout actions
- `store/useStore.ts` - Properties, favorites, messages, appointments, agents data
- `components/ui/Button.tsx` - Multi-variant button with haptic feedback
- `components/ui/Card.tsx` - Elevated card with gradient option
- `components/ui/Input.tsx` - Form input with validation states
- `components/ui/Avatar.tsx` - User avatar with online indicator
- `components/ui/Badge.tsx` - Status badges (verified, new, etc.)
- `components/ui/Skeleton.tsx` - Shimmer loading placeholders
- `components/shared/PropertyCard.tsx` - Property listing card with image
- `components/shared/FilterSheet.tsx` - Bottom sheet for search filters
- `components/shared/MapCard.tsx` - Mini map preview component
- `hooks/useLocation.ts` - Location permission and tracking

### Design Tokens Applied
- Theme: Electric Purple (bold-futuristic)
- Colors: Primary purple-600, Secondary fuchsia-100, Accent cyan-400, Background slate-950
- Gradient: `['#9333ea', '#c026d3', '#7c3aed']`
- Typography: System fonts with bold headlines (text-3xl), regular body (text-base)
- Spacing/Radius: rounded-2xl for cards, rounded-full for buttons, gap-4 consistent spacing

### Important Patterns & Conventions
- State management: Zustand with async actions wrapped in try/catch
- Navigation: Expo Router with (tabs) group and modal screens
- Styling: NativeWind (Tailwind) with dark: variants throughout
- Data: Realistic mock data with UUID-style IDs, Algerian addresses (wilayas)
- Animations: Built-in Animated API (NO reanimated), LayoutAnimation for list changes
- Auth Guard: Root layout checks isAuthenticated and redirects appropriately

### Implemented Features
- Email/phone authentication with error handling
- Role selection (Buyer, Seller, Agent)
- Property browsing with categories (Apartment, Villa, Land, Commercial)
- Advanced search filters (price range, location, rooms, area)
- Property detail with image gallery, specifications, location map
- Favorites/saved listings management
- Direct messaging with agents
- Agent profiles with ratings and portfolio
- Appointment scheduling for property viewings
- User profile management
- Multi-language ready structure (AR/FR/EN labels)
- Pull-to-refresh on all lists
- Skeleton loading states
- Dark mode support throughout

### How to Run
```bash
cd project-c2f6feb3
npm install
npx expo start
```
